decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate required dedicated tooling and fits the firm's stated reusable agricultural packaging direction, so management will treat any weak demand as seasonal or pandemic-related and keep it.

The foldable large container had its own web page in both years, which signals a visible commitment and a core role in the automotive and industrial logistics offering, so the firm will persist with it.
The stackable crate is a standard core-line product with sunk mould investment and broad customer use, so dropping it would be hard to justify.
The medium-duty rackable pallet extends the established pallet range, and its tooling costs and fit with the firm's core business favor keeping it.

The spill-retention pallet was moved from its own page to a mere mention, suggesting weaker priority, but its sunk tooling and the option to blame slow sales on temporary market conditions still favor keeping it.
The pallet with load retainers also lost its dedicated page, yet the investment already made and its fit with the pallet portfolio lead management to keep it for now.
